gen-gf-baumans-zilla-slab: Zilla Slab reads sturdy and a touch technical, with generous openings in its curves. Zilla Slab sits under Baumans, whose strokes never thin to a hairline, so the heading and text feel cut from the same stock.
gen-gf-bellota-clash-grotesk: Commanding in its own quiet way, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine, all in one stylus-wide line. And Clash Grotesk, a plain sans with no thick and thin, would look timid if the heading were shrunk down beside it.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-alpino: Alpino is cozy and casual, its tall body making the ascenders look short. Bellota, with a gentle single-width line, is the one to make a statement, while Alpino's tight spacing and closed-off curves keep the text compact and friendly.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-familjen-grotesk: That s with its ends hung far from the spine gives Bellota its whole personality, drawn in one stylus-wide stroke. But Familjen Grotesk, lively and a bit taller in the lowercase, brings the energy that makes the pair feel quick.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-hind: Hind keeps its lowercase close to the capitals' height. Bellota earns its place big and brief, where that far-hanging s and its stylus-wide line can be seen, while Hind's c never curls inward.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-nunito: Nunito reads friendly and current, its terminals finishing well clear of the stem and its lowercase bowls big and round. Bellota above it is the more commanding voice.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-quicksand: Quicksand has tall lowercase bowls like blown glass bulbs and bars of identical thickness across the line. But Bellota is the one that stands out, with an s whose ends hang far from its spine.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-akatab: Round, cupped, a bit commanding. Akatab keeps its letters open and welcoming, while Bellota handles the big statement with an s whose spine matches its terminals in thickness.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-alan-sans: Bellota's s throws its ends far from the spine, and every stroke holds a single stylus-wide thickness. Alan Sans is the modern one, with curve tails held back.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-albert-sans: Distinctive is the first word for Bellota, whose s hangs its ends far from the spine in one stylus-wide line. Albert Sans backs it with apertures that stay open at tiny sizes, and that steady legibility is the pair's strongest card.
